0022600025.text: The Atlanta Hawks (5-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East, on a two-game winning streak) host the Washington Wizards (4-4, second in the Southeast and 0.5 games back, eighth in the East, on a one-game losing streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup, the Hawks' 10th game of the season. For Atlanta, Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot, fracture) are out, while Asa Newell (toe), Jalen Johnson (ankle) and Jock Landale (hip) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions; for Washington, Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve) are out. The Hawks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 120-105 win in Washington on November 4, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
